draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 15 novembre 2026
draft.excerpt: L'Italia U21 batte la Francia 2-1 in amichevole internazionale. Spazio limitato per alcuni dei nostri giovani talenti.
draft.excerptEn: Italy U21 defeats France 2-1 in international friendly. Limited playing time for some of our young prospects.
draft.bodyIt:
Una giornata intensa per i nostri giovani azzurri nelle Nazionali giovanili.

**Emanuele Lulli e Giovanni Daffara** — L'Italia U21 batte 2-1 la Francia in una sfida internazionale importante: entrambi i calciatori rimangono in panchina per l'intera durata del match, ma assistono a una prova convincente della squadra. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOSk0xcU5VWFM3Q0x4NTJVT21xa3NvaGhLMEs4V1ZscnVBR1JNMlM1c1lNX3J3VVloR29JUkF4N1p0ZnJqR3BHRGh4dzBfZm1SaDhQMDlXOUp2TkFBTjltWVlaWG1pazdsVGFxSjFFT05uRm9pcUV2bXNHTlF2ckRuY1dIUnFNcV9pZjlhc0lGUmVRQ0g1eFptdGtucE43M2FvWGhIbllVeGRsMnd2bTRPaTZVNA?oc=5)

**Eddy Kouadio** — L'esterno monzese ha vissuto il suo primo esordio in Under 21, una tappa importante nel percorso di crescita con la Nazionale giovanile. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOemNpZUtKeHB1OHM0Y0cxaUhJdndnMVRQWFRtbGw3ckVnTFg0Q3F5anotZ3FnbWJ1aDFZM1FzTEdVbF9pOVY1bnlkRlQ5RUQ2T3ROSUc2T0FmTUxaVDF4ek9YQXVVUjBBTFdMbjlweXFoeDR1eEVWVW44MGtWbl9yeDFTTnZWd290aHo3UjN6VTB1WTQ2aXhjbEh3U0tjWGdwNGc?oc=5)

Sono ancora tante le rotazioni da valutare nei prossimi impegni internazionali.
draft.bodyEn:
An intense day for our young Azzurri in youth national team matches.

**Emanuele Lulli and Giovanni Daffara** — Italy U21 beat France 2-1 in an important international friendly: both players remained on the bench for the entire match, but witnessed a convincing performance from the squad. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOSk0xcU5VWFM3Q0x4NTJVT21xa3NvaGhLMEs4V1ZscnVBR1JNMlM1c1lNX3J3VVloR29JUkF4N1p0ZnJqR3BHRGh4dzBfZm1SaDhQMDlXOUp2TkFBTjltWVlaWG1pazdsVGFxSjFFT09uRm9pcUV2bXNHTlF2ckRuY1dIUnFNcV9pZjlhc0lGUmVRQ0g1eFptdGtucE43M2FvWGhIbllVeGRsMnd2bTRPaTZVNA?oc=5)

**Eddy Kouadio** — The Monza winger made his first Under 21 debut, an important milestone in his development with the youth national team. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxOemNpZUtKeHB1OHM0Y0cxaUhJdndnMVRQWFRtbGw3ckVnTFg0Q3F5anotZ3FnbWJ1aDFZM1FzTEdVbF9pOVY1bnlkRlQ5RUQ2T3ROSUc2T0FmTUxaVDF4ek9YQXVVUjBBTFdMbjlweXFoeDR1eEVWVW44MGtWbl9yeDFTTnZWd290aHo3UjN6VTB1WTQ2aXhjbEh3U0tjWGdwNGc?oc=5)

Plenty of rotation options still to be evaluated in the upcoming international fixtures.
